# The SIMD and newer extensions, 64-bit mode, Intel syntax.
#
# One or two cases per mnemonic of every extension rsasm has beyond SSE and
# AVX2, generated from GNU's opcode table by the fuzzer's form reader
# (tools/fuzz/simd.py) and kept where GNU as 2.47, llvm-mc 22 and rsasm all
# agree. They vary the vector length, the EVEX-only registers, memory operands
# at every disp8*N scale, writemasks, {z}, broadcast and rounding; the named
# compare predicates are represented by their `eq` spellings. The same file is
# in tools/gas-diff and tools/mc-diff; where the two references disagree, the
# case is in neither and the split is listed in tools/fuzz/x86.py.
# ---- AVX-512F and AVX-512VL --------------------------------------------------
